source_title: EdTech Does Not Remedy, It Amplifies
summary: This 2021 T4 Education interview turns Chinese edtech into an Education pressure source: technology scales where school has already become a score-optimization game, but it amplifies motivation, equity, creativity, and community conditions rather than repairing them.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: China's edtech boom rests on scarce educational opportunity, parent obsession, test-score tractability, and WeChat coordination.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The interview shows the school game becoming edtech-friendly because parents, students, teachers, and platforms are already organized around the rewarded score-and-opportunity game.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The world should be the classroom, and schools should break out of test-focused silos into community and real-world problems.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The line does not carry the Viking resilience mechanism by itself, but it is a direct early education-worldliness support for the broader rival-formation anchor.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Add edtech as an amplifier of the existing school game: when education is reduced to a solvable test-score problem, technology can scale feedback and tutoring, but it does not supply motivation, emotional support, creativity, or community.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns this because the active mechanism is school motivation, teacher/community formation, and the rewarded game. Platform Infrastructure owns only the WeChat/app layer when the source centers ownership or pipes.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use this source as the February 2021 bridge between the April 2020 online-schooling stress test and the 2026 creativity interview: April shows the online medium exposing teacher authority; February 2021 generalizes the failure into motivation, equity, creativity, and community; 2026 later turns creativity into evidence-based teacher practice.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Keep the chronology in Education rather than Living School unless the public pass is specifically about Jiang's positive school dream.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use technology worship as a compact example of process failure: facial recognition in classrooms looks modern, but Jiang says the correct process starts from the educational goal, such as engagement, and may choose a better teacher or a low-tech community intervention instead.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Mass Society owns facial recognition when it becomes population-scale surveillance; here the active pressure is educational goal-setting and mistaken tool worship.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Mention only in a later living-school comparison as an early positive constraint: AI and data are useful only if they force educational assumptions to face evidence and preserve teachers as a community of scholars.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education remains the primary home. Living School should receive this only when the question is model-correction, evidence, and future-forming pedagogy.

new_lens_seeds.title: Technology Amplifies The School Condition
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A tool does not cure a school; it magnifies the motivational, emotional, communal, and pedagogical condition already present, so a weak school can become more visibly weak while a strong learning community can use the same tool productively.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism applies beyond edtech whenever an institution buys technology before it has named the human process it needs to repair; later AI, surveillance, online schooling, and platform examples can be routed through the same test.

new_lens_seeds.title: Evidence Before Education Slogans
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: Education becomes more scientific when slogans such as well-being, creativity, engagement, and AI transformation are forced through clear goals, evidence, data, and classroom process instead of remaining conference language or technology fashion.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This seed links Jiang's education interviews to the broader Predictive History method: claims should become testable, models should revise, and tools should be judged by whether they deepen human formation.

chronology_notes.note: This source is dated 2021-02-05, after the April 2020 emergency online-schooling stress test and before later 2026 Education page sources; it should be treated as a mid-chronology bridge, not a current post-crackdown edtech claim.

Jiang dates China's equity-and-literacy buildout to 1949-1999 and uses the post-1999 market shift to explain changing teacher status; a public Education pass should preserve that older historical layer rather than treating teacher quality as a timeless cultural trait.

The COVID material is retrospective from early 2021: the gaokao delay and home-learning motivation gap are used as evidence that classroom community and family scaffolding matter beyond content delivery.

Hold technology-amplifies-school-condition and evidence-before-education-slogans as seeds until an Education synthesis pass decides whether either should become a durable lens point, a subsection, or remain folded into Education As A Soul Game.
